title: Sri Lanka Honeymoon Circuit
headline: Kandy’s lake, then Bentota sunsets and Colombo.
description: Five nights for two: Kandy’s temples, two nights on the west coast, then a last night in Colombo.
image_alt: Nine Arches Bridge and a train in the hills near Ella, Sri Lanka
price_label: Quoted for your dates and hotels
price_guidance: Honeymoon pricing depends on hotel category and whether you add a Peradeniya morning or a river boat. We confirm a written total before you reserve.
overview: A couple’s Sri Lanka with three stays: two nights by Kandy lake and the Temple of the Tooth, two on Bentota beach, then Colombo before you fly. Culture, then sea — without a hotel every night.
highlights: Two nights in Kandy with the Temple of the Tooth.
Optional Peradeniya gardens on the way south.
Two nights on Bentota or a neighbouring beach.
A last Colombo evening before departure.
why: Hills and sea in five nights, paced for two.
Dining and temple hours can be shaped around you.
ETA guidance for Indian passports, coordinated with your tickets.
inclusions: Airport and inter-hotel transfers in a private vehicle
exclusions: Site tickets and optional boats unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees
